```{r}
studyone <- read.csv(file = '../data/studyone.csv')
```

#data cleaning
```{r}
#study one
studyoneinteraction <-
  studyone %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,7,9)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = manip_like, "Original" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")

#study two
studytwointeraction <-
  studytwo %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,7,9)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = manip_like, "Original" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")

#studythree
studythreeinteraction <-
  studythree %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,8,10)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = manip_like, "Original" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")

#study four
studyfourinteraction <-
  studyfour %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,8,10)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = manip_like, "Original" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")


#across studies analyses
masterinteraction <- rbind(studyoneinteraction, studytwointeraction, studythreeinteraction, studyfourinteraction)
masterinteraction$outcome_type <- as.factor(masterinteraction$outcome_type)
masterinteraction$liking_scaled <- scale(masterinteraction$liking)
masterinteraction$rep_scaled <- scale(masterinteraction$rep)
contrasts(masterinteraction$outcome_type) <- c(-0.5,0.5)
```

#define BMRQ tertiles
```{r}
#define tertiles
studythreenonpre <- studythree[-(5) ]
studyfournonpre <- studyfour[-(5)]
all <- rbind(studyone, studytwo, studythreenonpre, studyfournonpre)

#define teritles
## for population cutoffs, use vTert = c(0,3.25,4.35,5)
## for teritle, use 
vTert = quantile(bmrq$bmrq_all, c(0:3/3))


#classify tertile class
bmrq$tert = with(bmrq, 
               cut(bmrq_all, 
                   vTert, 
                   include.lowest = T, 
                   labels = c("Anhedonic", "Hedonic", 
                              "Hyperhedonic")))

all_bmrq <- merge(bmrq, all, by.x="PublicID", by.y = "subject")

bmrq_interaction <-
  all_bmrq %>%
  subset(select=c(1,9,11,12,15,17)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = manip_like, "Original" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")

bmrq_interaction$outcome_type <- as.factor(bmrq_interaction$outcome_type)
bmrq_interaction$tert <- as.factor(bmrq_interaction$tert)
bmrq_interaction <- within(bmrq_interaction, tert <- relevel(tert, ref = "Hedonic"))


bmrq_interactionfam <-
  all_bmrq %>%
  subset(select=c(1,9,11,12,16,18)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = man_fam, "Original" = post_fam) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "familiarity")

bmrq_interactionfam$outcome_type <- as.factor(bmrq_interactionfam$outcome_type)
bmrq_interactionfam$tert <- as.factor(bmrq_interactionfam$tert)
bmrq_interactionfam <- within(bmrq_interactionfam, tert <- relevel(tert, ref = "Hedonic"))
```

#mini meta - liking ratings
```{r}
## model selection
#linear
linmodel <- lmer(liking_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=masterinteraction,control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"))
summary(linmodel)
test(emtrends(linmodel, ~outcome_type, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 14516))
r.squaredGLMM(linmodel)

#quadratic 
quadmodel <- lmer(liking_scaled ~  poly(rep_scaled,2,raw=TRUE)*outcome_type + (poly(rep_scaled,2,raw=TRUE)*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum),control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"), data=masterinteraction)
summary(quadmodel)
test(emtrends(quadmodel, ~outcome_type, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite",max.degree = 2, lmerTest.limit = 14516))
r.squaredGLMM(quadmodel)

#LRT model comparison
anova(quadmodel, linmodel)

## plotting quad model
newdata <- expand.grid(
  rep_scaled=seq(-1.150035,1.916726,0.001),
  outcome_type = c("Original", "Altered")
)
newdata$repscale_squared <- (newdata$rep_scaled)^2
predictions<- predictSE(quadmodel, newdata, se.fit = TRUE, print.matrix =
        TRUE, level = 0)

pred_minimeta <- cbind(newdata, predictions)

pred_minimeta$rep <- pred_minimeta$rep_scaled * attr(masterinteraction$rep_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteraction$rep_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$liking <- pred_minimeta$fit * attr(masterinteraction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteraction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$upper <- (pred_minimeta$fit + pred_minimeta$se.fit) * attr(masterinteraction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteraction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$lower <- (pred_minimeta$fit - pred_minimeta$se.fit) * attr(masterinteraction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteraction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:center')

labels <- subset(pred_minimeta, rep==median(pred_minimeta$rep))
labels$label_placement <- ifelse(labels$outcome_type=="Original", labels$upper+0.05,labels$lower-0.05)

likingoriginalvsaltered <-
ggplot(data=pred_minimeta, aes(x=rep, y=liking)) +
  geom_line(aes(col=outcome_type))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=upper, ymax=lower, fill=outcome_type),alpha=0.1) +
  ylab('Liking Rating') +
  xlab('Exposure (number of presentations)') +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(3,3.5,0.1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
   geom_label_repel(aes(label = outcome_type, y=label_placement, color=outcome_type),
                   na.rm = TRUE,
                   data=labels, 
                   min.segment.length = Inf,
                   point.size = NA,
                   family="Arial",
                   size=8
                   ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.2, aes(color=outcome_type), data=masterinteraction, alpha=0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'pointrange', aes(color=outcome_type), data=masterinteraction, alpha=0.5)

ggsave('../figures/likingoriginalvsaltered-withpoints.png', likingoriginalvsaltered, width=180, units="mm", dpi=350)
```

#mini meta - familiarity ratings
```{r}
## model selection
#linear
linmodelf <- lmer(familiarity_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=masterinteractionfam, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"))
summary(linmodelf)
test(emtrends(linmodelf, ~outcome_type, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 14585))
r.squaredGLMM(linmodelf)
#logarithmic 
masterinteractionfam$log_rep <- log10(masterinteractionfam$rep + 0.1)
masterinteractionfam$log_repscaled <- scale(masterinteractionfam$log_rep)
logmodelf <- lmer(familiarity_scaled ~ log_repscaled*outcome_type  + (log_repscaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=masterinteractionfam,control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"))
summary(logmodelf)
test(emtrends(logmodelf, ~outcome_type, "log_repscaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 14585))
r.squaredGLMM(logmodelf)

anova(linmodelf, logmodelf)

#plotting
newdata <- expand.grid(
  log_repscaled=seq(-1.961429,1.029559,0.001),
  outcome_type = c("Original", "Altered")
)
predictions<- predictSE(logmodelf, newdata, se.fit = TRUE, print.matrix =
        TRUE, level = 0)

pred_minimeta <- cbind(newdata, predictions)

pred_minimeta$log_rep <- pred_minimeta$log_repscaled * attr(masterinteractionfam$log_repscaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteractionfam$log_repscaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$rep <- 10^(pred_minimeta$log_rep)-0.1
pred_minimeta$familiarity <- pred_minimeta$fit * attr(masterinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$upper <- (pred_minimeta$fit + pred_minimeta$se.fit) * attr(masterinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$lower <- (pred_minimeta$fit - pred_minimeta$se.fit) * attr(masterinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:center')

labels <- subset(pred_minimeta, rep==median(pred_minimeta$rep))
labels$label_placement <- ifelse(labels$outcome_type=="Original", labels$upper+1,labels$lower+0.45)

familiarityoriginalvsaltered <-
ggplot(data=pred_minimeta, aes(x=rep, y=familiarity)) +
  geom_line(aes(col=outcome_type))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=upper, ymax=lower, fill=outcome_type),alpha=0.1) +
  ylab('Familiarity Rating') +
  xlab('Exposure (number of presentations)')+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
   geom_label_repel(aes(label = outcome_type, y=label_placement, color=outcome_type),
                   na.rm = TRUE,
                   data=labels, 
                   min.segment.length = Inf,
                   point.size = NA,
                   family="Arial",
                   size=8,
                  nudge_x = 6
                   ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.2, aes(color=outcome_type), data=masterinteractionfam, alpha=0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'pointrange', aes(color=outcome_type), data=masterinteractionfam, alpha=0.5)

ggsave('../figures/familiarityoriginalvsaltered-withpoints.png', familiarityoriginalvsaltered, width=180, units="mm", dpi=350)
```

#mini meta bmrq analyses - liking ratings
```{r}
bmrq_interaction$rep_scaled <- scale(bmrq_interaction$rep)
bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled <- scale(bmrq_interaction$liking)
contrasts(bmrq_interaction$outcome_type) <- c(-.5,.5)
bmrq_interaction <- within(bmrq_interaction, tert <- relevel(tert, ref = "Hedonic"))

quadmodela <- lmer(liking_scaled ~  poly(rep_scaled,2,raw=TRUE)*outcome_type*tert + (poly(rep_scaled,2,raw=TRUE)*outcome_type|PublicID) + (1|clipnum),control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"), data=bmrq_interaction)
summary(quadmodela)
r.squaredGLMM(quadmodela)
test(emtrends(quadmodela, ~tert, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 14561, adjust = "none", max.degree=2))

#getting the > hedonic contrasts for altered melodies, since original is reference level
emmeans(quadmodela,  pairwise ~ tert | rep_scaled, lmerTest.limit = 14492, adjust = "none")

newdata <- expand.grid(
  rep_scaled=seq(-1.155117,1.925195,0.001),
  outcome_type = c("Original", "Altered"),
  tert =c("Anhedonic","Hedonic", "Hyperhedonic")
)
newdata$repscale_squared <- (newdata$rep_scaled)^2
predictions<- predictSE(quadmodela, newdata, se.fit = TRUE, print.matrix =
        TRUE, level = 0)

pred_a <- cbind(newdata, predictions)
pred_a$rep <- pred_a$rep_scaled * attr(bmrq_interaction$rep_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(bmrq_interaction$rep_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_a$liking <- pred_a$fit * attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_a$upper <- (pred_a$fit + pred_a$se.fit) * attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_a$lower <- (pred_a$fit - pred_a$se.fit) * attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:center')

labels <- subset(pred_a, rep==median(pred_a$rep)) %>%
  subset(tert=="Hedonic")
labels$label_placement <- ifelse(labels$outcome_type=="Original", labels$upper+0.3,labels$lower-0.3)

updated_tertile_liking<-
  ggplot(data=pred_a, aes(x=rep, y=liking)) +
  geom_line(aes(col=outcome_type))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower, ymax=upper, fill=outcome_type),alpha=0.1) +
  ylab('Liking Rating') +
  xlab('Exposure (number of presentations)') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(title=element_text(family="Arial", size=24),
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
    strip.text.x = element_text(family="Arial",size=20)
  ) +
   scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00"))  +
   geom_label_repel(aes(label = outcome_type, y=label_placement, color=outcome_type),
                   na.rm = TRUE,
                   data=labels, 
                   min.segment.length = Inf,
                   point.size = NA,
                   family="Arial",
                   size=8
                   ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
   stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.2, aes(color=outcome_type), data=bmrq_interaction, alpha=0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'pointrange', aes(color=outcome_type), data=bmrq_interaction, alpha=0.5) +
    facet_grid(~tert) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(2.75, 3.00, 3.25,3.50,3.75))

ggsave(plot=updated_tertile_liking, file='../figures/updated_tertile_likingeithpoints.png', width=10)
```

#case study analyses -- liking
```{r}
#adding predictions to dataframe
studyfiveinteraction <-
  studyfive %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,8,10)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = manip_like, "Original" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")

studyfiveinteraction$rep_scaled <- scale(studyfiveinteraction$rep)

clips <- cbind(studyfiveinteraction[1:2],studyfiveinteraction[6])

newdata <- expand.grid(
  rep_scaled=c("-1.155117", "-0.385117", "0.769883", "1.539883"),
  outcome_type=c("Original", "Altered"),
  tert=c("Anhedonic", "Hedonic", "Hyperhedonic"),
  PublicID=c("220216BWEI", "220215NARE")
)
newdata$rep_scaled <- as.numeric(as.character(newdata$rep_scaled))

clips$rounded <- round(clips$rep_scaled,digits=2)

prediction<- predictSE(quadmodela, newdata, se.fit = TRUE, print.matrix =
        TRUE)
case_study <- cbind(newdata,prediction)

case_study$rep <- round(case_study$rep_scaled * attr(masterinteraction$rep_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(masterinteraction$rep_scaled, 'scaled:center'))
case_study$pred_liking <- case_study$fit * attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(bmrq_interaction$liking_scaled, 'scaled:center')

case_master<- merge(case_study,studyfiveinteraction, by.x=c("rep","PublicID","outcome_type"),by.y=c("rep","PublicID","outcome_type"))

case_master$squared_residual<-(case_master$liking - case_master$pred_liking)^2

anhedonic_pred <-case_master %>%
  subset(tert=="Anhedonic")
sum(anhedonic_pred$squared_residual)/2

hedonic_pred <-case_master  %>%
  subset(tert=="Hedonic")
sum(hedonic_pred$squared_residual)/2

hyperhedonic_pred <-case_master %>%
  subset(tert=="Hyperhedonic")
sum(hyperhedonic_pred$squared_residual)/2
```

#case study analyses -- familiarity
```{r}
#adding predictions to dataframe
studyfiveinteractionfam <-
  studyfive %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,9,11)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = man_fam, "Original" = post_fam) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "familiarity")

studyfiveinteractionfam$log_rep <- log10(studyfiveinteractionfam$rep + 0.1)
studyfiveinteractionfam$log_repscaled <- scale(studyfiveinteractionfam$log_rep)

newdata <- expand.grid(
  log_repscaled=c("-1.961255", "0.2244915", "0.7551278", "0.9515023"), #UPDATE
  outcome_type=c("Original", "Altered"),
  tert=c("Anhedonic", "Hedonic", "Hyperhedonic"),
  PublicID=c("220216BWEI", "220215NARE")
)
newdata$log_repscaled <- as.numeric(as.character(newdata$log_repscaled))

prediction<- predictSE(logmodelf, newdata, se.fit = TRUE, print.matrix =
        TRUE)
case_study <- cbind(newdata,prediction)

case_study$log_rep <- case_study$log_repscaled * attr(masterinteractionfam$log_repscaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(bmrq_interactionfam$log_repscaled, 'scaled:center')
case_study$rep <- round(10^(case_study$log_rep)-0.1)

case_study$pred_familiarity <- case_study$fit * attr(bmrq_interactionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(bmrq_interactionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:center')

case_master<- merge(case_study,studyfiveinteractionfam, by.x=c("rep","PublicID","outcome_type"),by.y=c("rep","PublicID","outcome_type"))

case_master$squared_residual<-(case_master$familiarity - case_master$pred_familiarity)^2

anhedonic_pred <-case_master %>%
  subset(tert=="Anhedonic")
sum(anhedonic_pred$squared_residual)/2

hedonic_pred <-case_master  %>%
  subset(tert=="Hedonic")
sum(hedonic_pred$squared_residual)/2

hyperhedonic_pred <-case_master %>%
  subset(tert=="Hyperhedonic")
sum(hyperhedonic_pred$squared_residual)/2
```
